newsitem.title: KENYA: Tea prices mixed at Kenyan auction.
newsitem.headline: Tea prices mixed at Kenyan auction.

text.p: Tea prices were mixed at the weekly Kenyan export auction on Monday amid good general demand at irregularly firm levels, traders said.
Brighter BP1s appreciated by three U.S. cents with mediums up by 3-5 cents. Brighter and medium PF1s were firm to seven cents easier while lower mediums were firm to three dearer.
The few brighter PDUSTs on offer held firm while mediums declined by 3-7 cents.
Clean bright liquoring fannings and all Dusts were irregularly dearer. BMFs gained value.
Pakistan blenders and Egypt were the main buyers.
